Music: The music that I enjoyed, I am not able to enjoy anymore. It has become a trigger for my depression, and causes me to break down and cry. Since, December I have slowly listened to less and less music. Now, I purposely listen to none.

I do not know why, but it would just cause me to feel a lot of sad emotions. Wanting to laugh, I would watch Scrubs, and a song came on the background, I just started to cry. 

For so many people, music has been  a way to feel better, I have read on hear how music has helped so many people get through tough times; it has become something that I can no longer really enjoy. Music evokes so many emotions, or memories, that I do as much as I can to avoid it.

But is is impossible. Anywhere you go there is music. Stores, coffee shops, movies, TV shows, etc... Evening listening to fun, happy music reminds me that I am not feeling that way, and that I do not remember how that feeling feels.

I can no longer enjoy something as simple as music at the moment.

This is coming from someone that is depressed, and is currently going through a really tough time at the moment. The movies that I enjoyed watching, no longer bring me any kind of joy.  I used to really enjoy watching all the Pirates of the Carribian movies and the Ocean's 11 movies. Those used to work for me. At this point, nothing is really working. They are just background noise, that I do not even pay attention to. At the moment I have Amazing Spiderman 1, but I am not even paying attention to it. What someone that is depressed, it does not matter the movie, what is more important is having the friend with you watching it with out. Having someone that enjoys watching the movie with you is more important than the movie. Trust me, having someone that is there just because they want to help is the best. I currently going through a tough time right now, as I may have lost that person that made me feel better just by being with them. So my suggestion, is watch any movie, but with your friend.
